what: Two-layer parallax of photo cells — the outer cell moves down by drift (px) from when it touches the screen bottom until it fully exits the top (negative goes up), and the photo·video inside moves in proportion to the distance between the screen center and its own center (÷ half screen height × its height × ratio), so each cell floats at a different speed. Below 768px both are halved. For sections with staggered cells like a photo collage

duration.Scroll: While the cell passes across the screen

options.drift: Distance in px the outer cell drops while passing, default 0 — Studio uses −20·10·30·40·100 per cell
options.ratio: Inner photo ratio, default .15 — 0 keeps the inner still. nu-brand uses .08, .1, .12, .15

note: The original scales the inside by only 1.01, so at screen edges an empty strip may show inside the cell — same in the original. If you dislike the strip, reduce ratio or enlarge the inside more
